name: Taxes And Tithe
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to faithfully fulfill their responsibilities regarding both taxes and tithes. Jesus rebukes those who meticulously tithe even small herbs yet neglect the more important matters of justice, mercy, and faith (Matthew 23:23), emphasizing that obedience to God's moral law is paramount. At the same time, Romans 13 instructs Christians to submit to governing authorities, recognizing that such powers are established by God and serve as His ministers, to whom tribute is rightly paid (Romans 13:1, 6). Together, these passages affirm a Christ-centered approach that honors God through both just living and respectful civic duty.
